description: The file defines an abstract class `BackgroundSyncScheduler` and a concrete implementation `ForegroundResumedSyncScheduler` that schedules periodic background sync operations in a Flutter app. It manages sync timing via a `Timer` when the app is in the foreground.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncScheduler
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for background sync schedulers with start and dispose methods.

classes.name: ForegroundResumedSyncScheduler
classes.description: A fallback scheduler that periodically triggers syncs when the app is resumed, using a timer.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the scheduler; in this implementation, sets up a periodic timer for sync.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources; cancels the active timer.
